exp1.note: quay-native-bootstrap has NO discrete binary instance Done-when clauses. Its instance objective is a product of quality factors (V_instance = skeleton x abi_symmetry x gate_correctness x skill_convergence) and convergence is the 5-criterion dual-threshold rule (proposal/README section 7). It HALTED not-converged at it88 (V_instance=0.6016), so done_when_met_count=0 throughout is correct. Source: docs/proposals/quay-bootstrap-experiment.md section 1 (bounded instance goal) + section 7 (convergence criteria); experiments/quay-native-bootstrap/README.md sections 5-7.

clauses: Core CLI/MCP/Web-UI three-way symmetry: abi-symmetry-equivalent script exists, covers every Core MCP tool surface also reachable via CLI and Web UI, runs in the automated suite, every symmetry gap closed or explicitly tracked (core_abi_symmetry).

Browser-driven Web UI verification: every Web UI page/flow reachable in packages/quay has at least one browser-automation-driven test confirming current behavior, committed to the automated suite (web_ui_verification).

Mock/log-file action-delivery verification mode: deterministic file-based recording mode for action.js deliverTrigger() is the default automated-test harness (no live manda daemon required to pass), with at least one separate non-blocking live-manda check (action_delivery).
Continued quay-native backlog work: each iteration report shows none of quay-native's 8 V-factors regressed below experiment 1's final stop-time snapshot (native_backlog_health).
exp2.note: 4 explicit Done-when clauses = the 4 V_instance factors. All met by end of it3 when core_abi_symmetry reached 1.0 (QC-003), other 3 already at 1.0; V_instance 0.80->1.0. Source: docs/proposals/quay-core-bootstrap-experiment-v2.md section 4 (four numbered 'Done when' items); experiments/quay-core-bootstrap/iterations/iteration-3.md.

clauses: ui_read_capability: every bounded capability bullet (list filter by status/label, sort by id/status, pagination, detail-page frontmatter + rendered markdown + back-nav, action buttons, no new write surface) implemented AND covered by a browser-automation test (factor=1.0).

visual_design_quality: every reachable page/flow passes both the mechanical threshold (Lighthouse accessibility >=90 and best-practices >=90, consistent styling) and the mandatory independent holistic visual review PASS verdict (factor=1.0).
verified_by_construction: at end of every iteration, 100% of capabilities/visual changes delivered so far have a committed browser-automation test (factor=1.0).
backlog_health: every iteration report reconfirms no regression against both inherited snapshots (quay-native's 8 V-factors and quay-core-bootstrap's V-factors) (factor=1.0).
exp3.note: 4 Done-when clauses = the 4 V_instance factors. Iteration logs show all four satisfied SIMULTANEOUSLY for the first time at it4 (iteration-4.md: 'SATISFIED THIS ITERATION - first time all four satisfied simultaneously', V_instance=1.0); it5 is observation-only. NOTE: the memory index line 'V_instance=1.0 by it4' is the correct all-met iteration; it5 was merely the formal HALT assessment. Source: docs/proposals/quay-webui-bootstrap-experiment-v3.md section 4 (four 'Done when' clauses); experiments/quay-webui-bootstrap/iterations/iteration-3.md and iteration-4.md.

exp4.note: quay-continuous-bootstrap is OPEN-ENDED by design: it has NO design-time-frozen Done-when checklist (proposal section 4.1 explicitly rejects the fixed-product-of-bounded-factors shape). V_instance is 4 durable dimensions (capability_breadth x usability_quality x verification_coverage x system_health) rescored against a moving gap list. Its only self-terminating state is PAUSE (section 4.5), not a binary done criterion. done_when_met_count=null throughout is correct. Source: docs/proposals/quay-continuous-bootstrap-experiment-v4.md sections 4.1-4.2 (no finish line) and 4.5 (PAUSE vocabulary).
